LanguageData.BLAP_EmulateGizmoDesc: Choose a specialist role from your ideoligion to emulate. You gain that role's stat modifiers and abilities. Work restrictions and apparel requirements are not inherited, and no specialist slot is occupied. Any change (switching or dropping emulation) has a 7-day cooldown.
LanguageData.BLAP_DevResetCooldownDesc: Immediately clears this pawn's emulation cooldown (debug only).
LanguageData.BLAP_EmulateMenuTitle: Choose a specialist role to emulate
LanguageData.BLAP_EmulateNoRoles: No emulatable specialist role exists in this ideoligion.
LanguageData.BLAP_EmulationHediffDesc: This person emulates the stat bonuses and abilities of the {0} role.
LanguageData.RoleRaisedExpectation: Holding the role of {0} shifts this person's expectations.
LanguageData.BLAP_SettingsInheritDisabledWorkTip: When on, the leader also inherits the emulated role's disabled work tags (e.g. medical specialist refuses violence). On by default; turn off for bonuses and abilities only.
LanguageData.BLAP_SettingsNote: Emulation entry: the 'Emulate specialist' command button on a selected leader.
